items.content_html: lupine.js is a full-featured web application that includes both Front-End and Back-End services. The Front-End, lupine.web, is an extremely lightweight framework using React TSX syntax. The Back-End, lupine.api, is a highly efficient and simplified framework similar to Express. It supports server-side rendering from scratch.

items.content_html: A lightweight utility for Node.js projects that accumulates items into fixed-size batches per key, preserving insertion order within each key. Streams items directly into their respective batches at runtime, eliminating the overhead of post-processing 1D arrays into chunks. It abstracts key-based batch management.
